Thanks Tess — and thanks Ellen for the intro.

High level plan: we typically run a ~4.5 hour virtual loop for this level (4 x 60 min interviews + two 15m buffers + a 30m hiring manager deep-dive). To reduce context switching we’d sequence the panel so domain-heavy interviews are adjacent. Proposed sequence (times are durations, not fixed clock slots):

1) System design (60m) — backend & infra focus
2) Algorithm / model architecture (60m) — ML systems
3) Product + cross-functional (60m) — PM/Design lens
4) Behavioral / leadership (60m) — bar-raiser style
5) Hiring manager deep-dive (30m) — team fit / roadmap

Buffers: 15m after interview 2 and interview 4 for quick sync and notes. Total ~4.5 hrs.

Can you confirm which of your windows above you’d prefer? If Thu Feb 19 looks good we’ll aim for a block starting at 12:00 PST; if you’d rather earlier we can shift Wed morning.

Marissa — can you spin up the loop agenda draft and interviewer roster (we’ll need a systems engineer, an ML infra engineer, a PM, and a leadership bar-raiser + hiring mgr). Laura — would you own sequencing/order? I’ll take the algorithm slot.

Thanks,
Vivek
